field.label: Enable alerts
field.help: Master switch. Disabling removes all Telegram checks from Monit and disables the daily summary job.

field.label: Bot token
field.help: From @BotFather (/newbot). Stored in config.xml, so it is included in configuration backups.

field.label: Chat ID
field.help: Message your bot once, then read chat.id from https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates.

field.label: Message prefix
field.help: Shown at the start of every alert.

field.label: CPU, memory and disk
field.help: CPU over 90% or memory over 85% for 5 minutes; root disk over 80% full.

field.label: CPU temperature
field.help: Alert when the CPU reaches the limit below.

field.label: Disk SMART health
field.help: Alert when a disk fails its SMART health check.

field.label: Firmware updates
field.help: Checks the repository every 6 hours, one alert when updates appear.

field.label: Boot and outage notices
field.help: Router started (also reveals power loss) and internet back online with outage window. Outages are reported after recovery.

field.label: Gateway down
field.help: WAN gateway monitor reports down for 2 minutes (delivered only if the internet still works through another path).

field.label: WAN quality degraded
field.help: Latency or packet loss above the limits below for 5 minutes.

field.label: Admin logins
field.help: Successful web GUI and SSH logins, and summaries of failed attempts.

field.label: Configuration changes
field.help: Who changed what, at most once per minute.

field.label: New devices
field.help: First DHCP lease for a MAC address on any network.

field.label: High-severity IDS alerts
field.help: Summary of new Suricata severity-1 alerts.

field.label: WireGuard connects
field.help: Peer connected / disconnected, with endpoint IP.

field.label: Daily summary
field.help: One message per day: uptime, WAN quality, outages, DNS queries, IDS hits, new devices, VPN peers, CPU/RAM/disk, firmware.

field.label: Daily summary hour (0-23)
field.help: Local time.

field.label: Encrypted config backup
field.help: After configuration changes (at most every 10 minutes) send config.xml encrypted with AES-256 to the chat. The file contains every secret on this firewall.

field.label: Backup encryption password
field.help: 16+ characters, keep it in your password manager. Decrypt: openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -md sha256 -in FILE.enc -out config.xml
